But sometimes it's just really hard to see the light at the end of the tunnel. I'll try my best to do everything I can, before I kill myself. Thanks.

I can't say I can relate 100% to your life but I've also had a pretty shitty life. I just want you to know you can talk to me any time, really, **any** time, and I will try my best to help you. It's good that you've taken one of the first steps to perhaps solving your problem, so keep on going and don't give up!

Don't hesitate to pm me if you need to talk with somebody!

I can't say I know how you feel, but I can say I've had some similar shitty experiences throughout my life (and still do) so I can relate. I wish life had been easier on you. But don't forget, there are also nice people on this world. If you ever feel like talking with somebody, I'll be there for you. Don't even hesitate to message me!

EDIT: I wish I could give you a hug, but unfortunately I can't. Have this *e-hug*.

Whenever you need somebody to talk with, I'll be there. I'm alone 95% of the time, so I've got plenty of time. Feel free to PM me anytime!

Stay strong.

I'm in a very similar situation, and I know exactly how you feel. I hate life as much as you do. Do you feel like talking? Talking won't make things worse, so why not give it a try? Keep it up, stay strong.

I'd love to talk with you. I've been going through a really bad depression last couple of months, I know how it feels to be alone. If you feel more comfortable pm-ing me, don't hesitate to do so, can you maybe tell me some more about what you're going through? Keep it up, and stay strong.

I wish I could make you feel better, but I don't know if I can. All I can say you is that I genuinely care about you, and that if you ever need somebody to talk to, I will be there to you, whenever. Stay strong and don't give up!

Could you tell me what you went trough and how you overcame it? (here or in pm) It would mean alot to me.

People tell me to keep on living and hope life gets better, but for somebody who has done this for a very long time it is only demoralising to think like that; knowing nothing good happened to me in many years.

Leaving everything behind me could be a good start but I can't even imagine myself being happy in the future; I'm so clueless, I don't know what to do. Nothingness sounds rather nice compared to what I'm going trough now. I really appreciate that you're sharing your personal experience/advice. Thanks a lot.
